evidence.detail: run/resume exposes --auto-merge

findings.remediation: Remove auto-merge and require a separately recorded approval decision.

evidence.detail: append writes research_append_ledger payload JSONB

findings.remediation: Write core entities to typed append-only tables and reserve JSONB for extension metadata.
findings.risk: Database constraints in typed tables are not enforced.
findings.title: Typed PostgreSQL schema is bypassed by a generic JSONB ledger

evidence.detail: state is a local JSON file and events JSONL

findings.remediation: Use the preregistered PostgreSQL task queue with leases, heartbeats and checkpoints.
findings.risk: Long-running work cannot provide safe concurrency or durable recovery.
findings.title: Atlas lacks a durable queue, lease, heartbeat and checkpoint

evidence.detail: private score matrix, samples and Parquet are not included

findings.remediation: Package immutable score rows and runtime lock, or expose content-addressed private replay inputs.
findings.risk: Summary integrity is verifiable but score-level CRPS and bootstrap claims are not independently reproducible.
findings.title: The pack is not a complete numerical replay bundle

evidence.detail: reported 6; completed-session count is 5

findings.remediation: Count only XNAS sessions whose regular close is on or before knowledge_cutoff.
findings.risk: Freshness metrics are wrong at pre-open cutoffs even though the candidate remains HOLD.
findings.title: Pre-open freshness includes an uncompleted current session

evidence.detail: EIA collection_failed has no receipt_id
receipt creation occurs only after a successful HTTP response

findings.remediation: Record exactly one terminal attempt outcome before HTTP and exactly one receipt outcome after receipt creation.
findings.risk: Reported 100% terminal coverage omits attempts that never created receipts.
findings.title: Collection failures are excluded from receipt terminal coverage

evidence.detail: path construction contains interpolation/linspace

findings.remediation: Generate paths from joint endpoint and trajectory samples.
findings.risk: Displayed path dynamics are not sampled joint trajectories.
findings.title: Path geometry is deterministically interpolated

evidence.detail: scheduled workflow invokes git push

findings.remediation: Use read-only scheduled jobs and a separately approved promotion workflow.
findings.risk: A scheduled research job can mutate the publication branch.
findings.title: Scheduled workflow commits and pushes directly

evidence.detail: 40 cache/compiled files are packaged

findings.remediation: Exclude __pycache__, pyc and mutable caches from future review packs.
findings.risk: Mutable interpreter caches add noise and weaken a clean-source replay claim.
findings.title: Review pack includes compiled caches

Alias candidates are hypotheses and are never promoted to exact matches.
